title: mammillaria standleyi
intro: Mammillaria standleyi, commonly known as the "Standley's Pincushion Cactus," is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. This plant is known for its small, round stems covered in fine, white spines and vibrant pink flowers. The health benefits of Mammillaria standleyi include its potential to lower blood sugar levels and aid in weight loss due to its high fiber content. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
